relationships.subject: diabetic neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: the distal skin PGP9.5-positive intraepidermal nerve fiber densities (IENFDs) were the lowest, whereas TRPV1-positive IENFDs were the highest in patients with DNP

key_findings: Patients with diabetic neuropathic pain had lowest PGP9.5 IENFD but highest TRPV1-positive IENFD in distal skin.
LASCA axon-reflex flare shows small fiber hypo-functionality in IGT and DNP.
